comparisons.evidence: P ranges across physical standardisation, redundancy, handoff protocols, preventive maintenance, behavioural expiry, tangible family play and work contracts: "Duplicate Life Modules," "Handoff Ledger," "Reversible Commitment Layer" and "Grandparenting Stagecraft." Q is diverse, but more of its pool clusters around compliance, care, housing and financial pooling.

P travels further from standard retiree services with mechanisms such as a property-facing "Personal Technical Rider," a relocation "damage report," and commitments that "expire unless renewed." Q has bold ideas, but several remain sophisticated extensions of familiar categories, including "portable business entity," "membership network" and "prepaid credits."

P explicitly makes imported rules operational: "responsibility is not transferred until the receiver positively acknowledges" drives the Time-Zone Relay Desk, while "interventions should be reversible" drives automatic commitment expiry. Q's derivative and migration metaphors generate useful ideas, but finalists such as "Care-Hours Futures" and "Home-Equity-to-Habitat Swap" resemble direct financial product analogies more than deeply transformed rules.

P's winner has frequent use, broad applicability and a credible payer: "Properties certify compatibility before the person arrives." Q's Jurisdiction Autopilot has a narrower, highly observable pain and fast test: "proposes itinerary changes" before thresholds are crossed. Each is plausibly the strongest practical choice under a different weighting of breadth versus urgency.

P converts assumptions into cheap kill tests, such as "Kill the idea if clarification cycles erase the time-zone advantage" and testing whether ledger entries "become stale." Q names serious risks—"clinical liability," "adverse selection" and "provider insolvency"—but generally stops at identifying them rather than specifying decisive falsification.

P states sharp inversions such as "Consistency—not variety" and treating distance as "a storytelling mechanic." Q is equally specific in reframing the problems: "avoiding a threshold" rather than filing afterward, authority rather than tracking, and converting housing wealth into "spatial optionality."

note: P's biggest advantage is disciplined, load-bearing transfer from unrelated domains; Q's strength is commercially legible infrastructure ideas with unusually concrete systemic failure modes.
